The combination of precise strain gauge with high resolution tension indicator is the perfect fit for customers aiming for superior product quality. - Digital Indicator for high speed measurements. - Unique design for multiple applications. - Special Coating for easy flow of material on guides. ## Features & Benefits ### Features - Dynamically balanced special quoted pulleys. - Datalogger option for monitoring and analysing data. - Analog output suitable for process control application. - Digital output for alarm integration. - Industry 4.0 compliant. - Flexibility to customise design as per requirements. ### Benefits - Easy integration with the exiting process. - Easy diagnosis with accurate data. - High longevity. - No maintenance. ## Technical Specification
**Specification** **WTI-90-40** **WTI-100-40**

## Process Overview & Schematic The following diagrams illustrate the various industrial applications and system integration components. **Industrial Processes:** - Extruder - Buncher - Stranding - Twister - Wire Drawing - Laying **System Components:** - Monitor - Printer - Hard Drive - Die - Lub Bath - Keyboard - Pick Up Spool - Motor - Traverse Table - Traverse Motion Motor **Image Descriptions:** - **Image 1:** A wire tension measurement device integrated into an industrial assembly line, featuring a path for wire to move through a tensioner, multiple pulleys, and a wire exit point. - **Image 2:** "Laying" process diagram showing wire being pulled through a tensioning unit, then into a spooling chamber. - **Image 3:** Comprehensive assembly line diagram showing wire passing through various stations, including tensioning, drawing, and output spooling. - **Image 4:** Schematic for "Wire Drawing" showing the full process chain: Monitor, Hard Drive, Printer, Keyboard, Wire input through a Die, Lubrication Bath, and final Pick Up Spool driven by a Traverse Motion Motor. ## Applications
